label: sdc02_0130_reception_01
text: How can I help you today?

label: sdc02_0130_select_01
text: I want to join the BB League!

label: sdc02_0130_select_02
text: Never mind, I’m good...

label: sdc02_0130_reception_02
text: Ah. It says here that you’re an exchange student,\nwhich means you’re not technically enrolled here\r\nat our academy...

label: sdc02_0130_dragonbb_01
text: Oh, don’t mind that![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0130_dragonbb_02
text: We Elite Four talked it over real quick. My friend\nhere’s good to join.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0130_reception_03
text: I don’t mean to sound rude, but I’m not sure if I\ncan take what you say at face value, Drayton...

label: sdc02_0130_brother_01
text: No, he’s telling the truth.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0130_brother_02
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I’m allowing [VAR 0x0100(0000)]
to
join
the
BB League.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0130_reception_04
text: Yes, Champion! One moment, please...

label: sdc02_0130_dragonbb_03
text: Didn’t expect you to ride up in shining armor and\nsave the day.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0130_brother_03
text: I’ve got a feeling you’re trying to play puppet\nmaster...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0130_brother_04
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]But if I get a shot at battling
[VAR 0x0100(0000)],
then
that’s
fine
with me.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0130_dragonbb_04
text: Heh heh. That’s just peachy.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0130_brother_06
text: You better not go losing to anyone until our\nbattle.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0130_select_03
text: I’ll try my best!

label: sdc02_0130_select_04
text: Like I’d lose!

label: sdc02_0130_brother_08
text: I’m not a little kid anymore. And you’ll know it\nwhen I show you how the best of the best battle.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0130_sister_01
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Kiki! You shouldn’t talk to
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]
like
that...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0130_brother_09
text: Shut it, Sis.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0130_brother_10
text: Looking forward to seeing you climb the ranks.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0130_sister_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I’m sorry, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
Kiki
was
really
acting
out,
wasn’t he?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0130_sister_04
text: That was my first time talking to him in a while,\ntoo. Man, such an attitude...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0130_dragonbb_05
text: Well, he’s Mr. Big-Deal Mighty Champion,\nafter all.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0130_sister_05
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Drayton, you’re the one who dragged
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]
into
all
this
BB
League
drama,
aren’t you?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0130_dragonbb_06
text: Me? No way. This was all h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]iser idea![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0130_dragonbb_08
text: That’s the spirit. Feeling that human urge to do\ngreat things, right?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0130_dragonbb_09
text: “No...doubt about it!”\nHear that, Carmine? [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe’s hungry for action![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0130_sister_06
text: I dunno, I think something fishy’s going on...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0130_sister_07
text: But, well...if you’re gonna do this, you might as\nwell do your best. I’ll be cheering for you.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0130_sister_08
text: And please...keep an eye on Kiki for me.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0130_reception_05
text: Thank you for waiting! Your entry into the\nBB League is complete!

label: sdc02_0130_dragonbb_10
text: Great timing.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0130_reception_06
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)] is cleared to compete
in
the
BB League!

label: sdc02_0130_reception_07
text: Usually, you’d start by battling regular students\nand climbing the ranks...

label: sdc02_0130_reception_08
text: But seeing as how you’ve got recommendations\nfrom several Elite Four members and Director\r\nCyrano, you’ll start from a higher rank.

label: sdc02_0130_reception_09
text: You’ll skip straight to challenging the Elite Four\nat their respective bases in the Terarium. Once\r\nyou clear their trials, that is.

label: sdc02_0130_reception_10
text: I’ll go ahead and mark their locations in your\nRotom Phone now!

label: sdc02_0130_reception_11
text:
To challenge the Elite Four, you’ll need [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]BP[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], which
you can earn by doing [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]BBQs[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].\c
Then, if you defeat all the members of the Elite
Four, you can challenge the Champion.

label: sdc02_0130_reception_12
text: All right, then! Best of luck in the BB League!

label: sdc02_0130_dragonbb_11
text: You can start with whichever of us you want.\nYour call.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0130_dragonbb_12
text: Any time you want to battle one of us, you’ll\nhave to do a fun little trial we cooked up first.\r\nSounds good, right?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0130_dragonbb_13
text: Catch you in the Terarium, bud![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0130_reception_npc
text: Best of luck in the BB League!
